result.markdown:
# Traffic Jump in Grand Tunis Due to Stadium Event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event
- **Confidence:** high (External event timing and location match the traffic and user spike perfectly on the affected sites.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-18 19:30 to 2026-09-18 22:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-18 19:11
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003

## Summary

A football match at Stade Olympique de Rades caused a massive increase in mobile traffic and active users.

Traffic, active users, and PRB utilisation spiked across three sites in Grand Tunis for approximately two hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-18 19:11: Football match started at Stade Olympique de Rades. [EVT-003]
- 2026-09-18 19:30: Earliest traffic and user KPI onset above baseline on S-TUN-001. [T6]
- 2026-09-18 19:45: Alert ALR-0019 started for active users, download volume, and PRB utilisation spikes. [ALR-0019]
- 2026-09-18 22:00: Alert ALR-0019 ended and KPIs recovered to baseline. [ALR-0019, T6]
- 2026-09-18 22:11: Football match ended at Stade Olympique de Rades. [EVT-003]

## Evidence

- Active users, download volume, and PRB utilisation spiked on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [ALR-0019, T6]
- A football match occurred at Stade Olympique de Rades from 19:11 to 22:11. [EVT-003]
- S-TUN-003 experienced the worst active user spike, rising from 258 to 572. [ANM-000208]
- S-TUN-003 download volume spiked from 35,477 to 77,173 MB. [ANM-000209]
- S-TUN-001 PRB utilisation spiked with a z-score of 8.5, rising from 31 to 66.8 percent. [ANM-000211]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event**: confirmed. Timing and location of the stadium football match align perfectly with the traffic and user surge on nearby sites. [EVT-003, T6]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-B: rejected. Traffic increased rather than dropped, contradicting any transport link failure. [T6]

## Ruled out

- LNK-TUN-01-B: Traffic increased across sites rather than experiencing drops or disconnects.
- LNK-TUN-01-A: Traffic increased across sites rather than experiencing drops or disconnects.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor stadium event schedules to proactively anticipate traffic spikes.
- Ensure sufficient capacity on sites near Stade Olympique de Rades during major matches.

## Sources

- `EVT-003`: stadium_event (TUN, near S-TUN-001) 2026-09-18 19:11 -> 2026-09-18 22:11: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (expected attendance 40,000)
- `T6`: query_kpis(entity_type=site, entity_ids=['S-TUN-001', 'S-TUN-002', 'S-TUN-003'], metrics=['dl_volume_mb', 'active_users', 'prb_util_pct'], start=2026- -> Deviation in 9 of 9 series. Earliest onset 2026-09-18 19:30: S-TUN-001 dl_volume_mb above baseline.
- `ALR-0019`: ended alert from 2026-09-18 19:45: 3 site(s) (S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003); metrics: active_users, dl_volume_mb, prb_util_pct
- `ANM-000208`: S-TUN-003 active_users spike, z 14.0, baseline 258 -> 572
- `ANM-000209`: S-TUN-003 dl_volume_mb spike, z 11.5, baseline 35477 -> 77173
- `ANM-000211`: S-TUN-001 prb_util_pct spike, z 8.5, baseline 31 -> 66.8
- `LNK-TUN-01-B`: fiber link, TUN, 12.0 km, 10.0 Gbps
- `LNK-TUN-01-A`: fiber link, TUN, 12.8 km, 10.0 Gbps

report.title: Traffic Jump in Grand Tunis Due to Stadium Event

confounders.why: A major RECTIFIER_FAULT alarm at the venue site S-TUN-001 that cleared by itself within minutes; availability and quality KPIs were not affected.

truth.notes: trap=expected_event_looks_like_fault; Traffic surge around the stadium caused by a scheduled event; not an incident. Trap: every venue site raises HIGH_PRB and S-TUN-001 also raises a major RECTIFIER_FAULT alarm that clears by itself, so the venue looks faulty. Settled by: (1) availability stays at 100 % and RRC success and drop rate stay normal at all venue sites; (2) the major alarm clears within minutes and moves no KPI; (3) the external event covers the region, the evening and the venue sites, and extra traffic with high PRB is what the event explains.
